Shatrughan Sinha Alleges BJP IT Cell Behind Sonakshi Sinha's Trolling

Actor and politician Shatrughan Sinha has accused the BJP's IT cell of orchestrating online trolling against his daughter, actress Sonakshi Sinha. Sinha stated that the trolling was manufactured and aimed at his daughter for her perceived silence on Jharkhand protests. He also mentioned Sonakshi's past support for underprivileged children in Jharkhand and alluded to her political ambitions. Sinha asserted that Sonakshi remains resilient against such negative campaigns.
